arxiv-2101-03662.title: Generating Large Cats with Nine Lives: Long-Lived Macroscopically Distinct Superposition States in Atomic Ensembles
arxiv-2101-03662.creator: Wei Qin, Adam Miranowicz, Hui Jing, Franco Nori
arxiv-2101-03662.description: Abstract We propose to create and stabilize long-lived macroscopic quantum superposition states in atomic ensembles. We show that using a fully quantum parametric amplifier can cause the simultaneous decay of two atoms and, in turn, create stabilized atomic Schrödinger cat states.

arxiv-2203-00716.title: Computing Bounds on L ∞ L_{\infty} -induced Norm for Linear Time Invariant Systems Using Homogeneous Lyapunov Functions
arxiv-2203-00716.creator: Hassan Abdelraouf, Gidado-Yisa Immanuel, Eric Feron
arxiv-2203-00716.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Hassan Abdelraouf, Gidado-Yisa Immanuel, Eric Feron. Quadratic Lyapunov function has been widely used in the analysis of linear time invariant (LTI) systems ever since it has shown that the existence of such quadratic Lyapunov function certifies the stability of the LTI system. In this work, the problem of finding upper and lower bounds for the L ∞ L_{\infty} -induced norm of the LTI system is considered.

arxiv-2203-07384.title: Alpha states demystified
arxiv-2203-07384.description: Abstract We continue our study of factorizing theories of dilaton gravity, characterized by a universal bilocal interaction. All such factorizing theories can be shown to have discrete spectra, distinguished only by their local dilaton potentials. We show how such theories can be used to construct all alpha-states in the Hilbert space of baby universes of ordinary JT gravity.

arxiv-2207-01478.title: Phase Diagram Detection via Gaussian Fitting of Number Probability Distribution
arxiv-2207-01478.creator: Daniele Contessi, Alessio Recati, Matteo Rizzi
arxiv-2207-01478.description: Abstract We investigate the number probability density function that characterizes sub-portions of a quantum many-body system with globally conserved number of particles. We put forward a linear fitting protocol capable of mapping out the ground-state phase diagram of the rich one-dimensional extended Bose-Hubbard model: The results are quantitatively comparable with more sophisticated traditional and machine learning techniques.

arxiv-2210-16597.title: Low energy models of string theory
arxiv-2210-16597.creator: Poula Tadros and Iiro Vilja
arxiv-2210-16597.description: Abstract String theory is the prime candidate for the theory of everything. However, it must be defined in ten dimensions to be consistent. To get 4D physics, the 6 other dimensions should be curled up in a small compact manifold, this procedure is called string compactification.

arxiv-2307-04241.title: Light trapping using dimer of spherical nanoparticles based on titanium nitride for plasmonic solar cells Journal: opticajournal Publication type: Research Article
arxiv-2307-04241.creator: Nowshin Akhtary, 1 Ahmed Zubair 1,*
arxiv-2307-04241.description: Abstract Light-trapping mechanisms with plasmonics are an excellent way to increase the efficiency of photovoltaics. Plasmonic dimer-shaped nanoparticles are effective in light absorption and scatterings, and there is hardly any research on dimer TiN nanoparticle-based PV. This paper demonstrated that titanium nitride could be a suitable substitute for other plasmonic materials in the visible and near-infrared spectrum.

arxiv-2407-02309.title: Semantically Guided Representation Learning For Action Anticipation
arxiv-2407-02309.creator: Anxhelo Diko, Danilo Avola, Bardh Prenkaj, Federico Fontana, Luigi Cinque
arxiv-2407-02309.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Anxhelo Diko, Danilo Avola, Bardh Prenkaj, Federico Fontana, Luigi Cinque. Action anticipation is the task of forecasting future activity from a partially observed sequence of events. However, this task is exposed to intrinsic future uncertainty and the difficulty of reasoning upon interconnected actions. Unlike previous works that focus on extrapolating better visual and temporal information, we concentrate on learning action representations that are aware of their semantic interconnectivity based on prototypical action patterns and contextual co-occurrences.

arxiv-2503-08733.title: Are dark matter and dark energy omnipresent?
arxiv-2503-08733.creator: Richard Lieu
arxiv-2503-08733.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Richard Lieu. A set of temporal singularities (transients) in the mass-energy density and pressure, bearing a specific mathematical structure which represents a new solution to the continuity equation ( i.e. conservation of mass-energy) and satisfying the strong energy condition, is proposed to account for the expansion history of a homogeneous Universe, and the formation and binding of large scale structures as a continuum approximation of their cumulative effects.

arxiv-2506-22466.title: Conversations with Andrea: Visitors’ Opinions on Android Robots in a Museum
arxiv-2506-22466.creator: Marcel Heisler, Christian Becker-Asano
arxiv-2506-22466.description: Abstract The android robot Andrea was set up at a public museum in Germany for six consecutive days to have conversations with visitors, fully autonomously. No specific context was given, so visitors could state their opinions regarding possible use-cases in structured interviews, without any bias.

arxiv-2507-23705.title: J1250+0455AB an ultracool binary in a hierarchical triple system 2024 J1250+0455AB an ultracool binary in a hierarchical triple system – References
arxiv-2507-23705.creator: Sayan Baig, R. L. Smart, Hugh R.A. Jones, E. Pinna, A. Sozzetti, Gemma Cheng, Felice Cusano, Fabio Rossi, Cedric Plantet, Guido Agapito
arxiv-2507-23705.description: Abstract We report the discovery of the ultracool dwarf binary system J1250+0455AB, a low-mass (M ⊙ tot < {}_{\mathrm{tot}}< 0.2 M ⊙ ) system in which the components straddle the M/L dwarf boundary. The binary was resolved through near-infrared adaptive optics imaging with LUCI1-SOUL on the Large Binocular Telescope, revealing a projected angular separation of 0.17 ± \pm 0.

arxiv-2510-08386.title: Optimal quantum spectroscopy using single-photon pulses
arxiv-2510-08386.creator: Sourav Das, Aiman Khan, Francesco Albarelli, Animesh Datta
arxiv-2510-08386.description: Abstract We provide the ultimate precision attainable in spectroscopy of a quantum emitter using single-photon pulses. We find the maximum for estimating the linewidth to be independent of the details of the emitter’s bare Hamiltonian while that for the detunings not to be so. We also identify optimal pulse shapes attaining these precisions.

pmc-11471158.title: Empowering the circular economy practices: Lifecycle assessment and machine learning-driven residual value prediction in IoT-enabled microwave oven
pmc-11471158.creator: Asif Iqbal, Sonia Akhter, Shahed Mahmud, Lion Mahmud Noyon
pmc-11471158.description: In an era of resource scarcity and environmental concerns, integrating Internet of Things (IoT) technology into the circular economy (CE), particularly for household appliances like microwaves, is crucial. The lack of systematic assessment of their post-use residual values often reduces utilization and shortens lifespans. Inadequate disposal and management contribute to electronic waste and environmental pollution.

pmc-11545778.title: The Interrelationship of Benefit Finding, Stigma, and Suicide Risk Among Patients with Schizophrenia and Their Caregivers: A Six-Month Follow-Up Study
pmc-11545778.creator: Heng Lee, Pin-Han Peng, Nien-Mu Chiu, Yu-Chi Huang, Pao-Yen Lin, Chi-Fa Hung, Yu Lee, Liang-Jen Wang, Daniele Giansanti
pmc-11545778.description: Objective: This study aimed to assess the dyadic dynamics of benefit finding, stigma, and suicide risk on the depression severity of individuals with schizophrenia and their caregivers. Methods: We prospectively recruited a total of 72 individuals with schizophrenia and 72 caregivers of individuals with schizophrenia from a medical center in Taiwan between August 2022 and July 2023.

pmc-11629698.title: Exon 1-targeting miRNA reduces the pathogenic exon 1 HTT protein in Huntington's disease models
pmc-11629698.creator: Marina Sogorb-Gonzalez, Christian Landles, Nicholas S Caron, Anouk Stam, Georgina Osborne, Michael R Hayden, David Howland, Sander van Deventer, Gillian P Bates, Astrid Vallès, Melvin Evers
pmc-11629698.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Huntington’s disease (HD) is a fatal neurodegenerative disease caused by a trinucleotide repeat expansion in exon 1 of the huntingtin gene (HTT) that results in toxic gain of function and cell death.

pmc-12472093.title: A Multifunctional Reconfigurable Terahertz Metasurface Enabling Spin-Decoupled Logic Operations and Holography
pmc-12472093.creator: Zou Long, Zhengji Xu, Alexander N Obraztsov
pmc-12472093.description: We present a multifunctional, reconfigurable terahertz metasurface built from dual split-ring resonators combining photosensitive silicon and metallic elements. By hybridizing structural and Pancharatnam–Berry phase control, the device achieves spin-decoupled manipulation of circularly polarized wavefronts and an optical, light-intensity-driven reconfiguration mechanism.

pmc-12693414.title: Influence of Layer Thickness and Extrusion Temperature on the Mechanical Behavior of PLA–Flax TPMS Sandwich Structures Fabricated via Fused Filament Fabrication
pmc-12693414.creator: Gabriele Marabello, Mohamed Chairi, Mariasofia Parisi, Guido Di Bella
pmc-12693414.description: Highlights What are the main findings? Gyroid PLA–flax TPMS sandwiches printed via FFF were characterized in terms of flexure and compression. Flexural behavior was skin-dominated, with best strength at 0.28 mm/200 °C, and ANOVA confirmed the significant effects of temperature and layer height. Compressive behavior was core-dominated, showing cellular collapse with first-collapse stresses of 6.3–8.

pmc-13145736.title: ABSTRACT NUMBER: ESOC2026A85 A PUBLIC HEALTH CHALLENGE: STROKE SYMPTOM RECOGNITION AND EMERGENCY RESPONSE IN BRAZIL - A SYSTEMATIC REVIEW AND META-ANALYSIS
pmc-13145736.creator: Viviane D E H Zetola, Luana Makita, Gisele Sampaio Silva, Marcos Lange, Bruna Maschi, Luísa Visentini, Victoria Souza, André Fagundes, Henrique Neves, Sheila Cristina Ouriques Martins
pmc-13145736.description: Background and aimsStroke remains a major public health challenge in Brazil. In 2012, the Ministry of Health implemented the Stroke Care Line (Resolution 665/2012), emphasizing public education and prevention as key elements of effective management. Despite these initiatives, the population’s ability to recognize stroke and respond appropriately remains uncertain. We aimed to evaluate stroke awareness among the Brazilian general population.

pmc-13582324.creator: Pan Jiang, Mengqing Zhou, Yuhong Liao, Wenbo Du, Min Liu
pmc-13582324.description: Post-weaning estrus return is a critical determinant of reproductive efficiency in the swine industry. While the gut microbiome, particularly bacteria, has been significantly associated with estrus return in sows, the role of the gut mycobiome and its cross-kingdom interactions with bacteria in this context remains largely unexplored.
